stories.title: India GDP growth supports EV expansion
stories.summary: India's real GDP grew 7.7 percent in FY26, maintaining its status among the world's fastest-growing major economies. Society of Indian Automobile Manufacturers President Shenu Agarwal stated this economic performance creates favourable conditions for the expansion of sustainable mobility solutions and the development of necessary charging infrastructure across the country.

stories.title: India
stories.summary: Mumbai: India's strong economic growth is creating fresh opportunities for the electric vehicle (EV) industry, with rising incomes, urbanisation and demand for cleaner transportation driving the country's shift towards sustainable mobility. India EV sales reach 2.3 million units
stories.summary: India's electric vehicle market has grown from 50,000 units sold in 2016 to 2.3 million units in 2025. The transition is described as a key pillar for a cleaner future, supported by policy initiatives, technological innovation and a significant rise in consumer adoption over the past decade.

stories.title: Government defends ethanol-blended petrol programme
stories.summary: The Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas has issued a clarification regarding the E20 fuel programme, rebutting claims of technical issues. The government maintains the rollout follows extensive laboratory testing, field trials and stakeholder consultations, asserting that the initiative is backed by scientific validation and real-world operating experience.

stories.title: Non-metro cities lead India passenger vehicle growth
stories.summary: Non-metro urban markets accounted for 55 percent of incremental passenger vehicle registrations in India between January and October. While overall registrations grew 18.4 percent to 4.56 million units, rural markets recorded the fastest growth rate at 27 percent, despite holding a smaller share of total volume.

stories.title: Study projects 61 percent reduction in India import bill via EVs
stories.summary: Accelerated electric vehicle adoption could reduce India's combined oil and battery import bill by 61 percent by 2050, according to a study by the International Council on Clean Transportation. The projection assumes the country continues to rely entirely on imported batteries for its road transport fleet.

stories.title: India electric vehicle market share reaches 8.8 percent
stories.summary: Former NITI Aayog CEO Amitabh Kant stated that India's battery electric vehicle market share reached 8.8 percent in September 2026, surpassing the 6.8 percent share reported in the United States. Kant noted that further growth remains contingent on the development of stronger charging infrastructure.

India also needs to strengthen its charging infrastructure to support the rising number of electric vehicles on the roads, Amitabh Kant said. Better access to charging

stories.title: Volkswagen unveils Tengo SUV in South Africa
stories.summary: Volkswagen has unveiled the sub-4-metre Tengo SUV in South Africa, with production underway at the Kariega plant and a launch anticipated in 2027. The vehicle was developed with engineering teams from Brazil and is intended as a right-hand-drive offering for international markets.

stories.title: Hyundai reveals Neira electric MPV
stories.summary: Hyundai has unveiled the production-ready Neira electric MPV in Indonesia. The seven-seater vehicle shares its design and platform with the Kia Carens Clavis EV, highlighting the company's strategy of utilizing shared products within the Hyundai Motor Group portfolio.

stories.title: Hyundai plans four new SUV launches for 2027
stories.summary: Hyundai intends to launch four new SUVs in India in 2027 as part of a strategy to introduce 26 models by 2030. The lineup includes the Ioniq P, an entry-level electric sub-4-metre SUV based on the E-GMP platform, featuring an electric sunroof and a premium cabin.

stories.title: JSW to debut as independent car brand in December
stories.summary: JSW will officially enter the Indian automotive market on December 4, focusing primarily on new energy vehicles. The company plans to launch a new SUV every three to four months, starting with the Combat, a rebadged version of the Jetour T2.

stories.title: Tata and Mahindra prepare seven-seater EV launches
stories.summary: Tata Motors and Mahindra Automotive are both moving to expand their electric vehicle portfolios with seven-seater models. The Tata Safari EV is expected to launch in January 2027, following the market success of Mahindra's XEV 9S in the same segment.

stories.title: Volkswagen reveals 333hp T-Roc R
stories.summary: Volkswagen has unveiled the 2027 T-Roc R, featuring 48V mild-hybrid technology and 333hp. The performance SUV includes standard all-wheel drive and torque vectoring. The company claims it is currently its most powerful SUV available in the European market.

stories.title: Maruti Brezza leads October sub-4-metre SUV sales
stories.summary: The Maruti Brezza was the best-selling sub-4-metre SUV in India during October 2026, with 22,436 units sold. The figure represents an increase of 10,364 units compared to October 2025, while other models including the Kia Sonet and Mahindra Bolero recorded a decline in sales.

stories.title: Toyota Innova Hycross facelift teased ahead of 25 November launch
stories.summary: Toyota has released new teasers for the 2027 Innova Hycross, showing a new grille design and a front parking camera. The updated MPV features a detached logo and new LED DRLs. Prices for the refreshed model will be announced on 25 November.

stories.title: Kia discontinues iMT variants of Seltos SUV
stories.summary: Kia India has permanently removed the iMT gearbox option from its Seltos SUV lineup. The change affects the 1.5L turbo petrol engine variants, including the HTE trim. The manufacturer continues to compete in the Indian market with a portfolio of SUVs and MPVs.

stories.title: Motorcycle sales rise 18.6 percent in October 2026
stories.summary: India's top 10 best-selling motorcycles reached 11,34,833 units in October, an 18.6 percent increase over the previous year. Hero Splendor led the market with 4,15,144 units, accounting for over one-third of the total volume. TVS Raider recorded the sharpest decline among the leading models.

stories.title: Royal Enfield plans 250cc bikes to tap rising demand from young upgraders - ET Auto
TVS expects scooters to reach 50 percent of two-wheeler market
stories.summary: TVS Motor expects scooters to account for half of India's two-wheeler market within two years. CEO K N Radhakrishnan noted that current sales are at 41 percent, with electric vehicles representing 9.7 percent of retail volume in October. The company anticipates a 45 percent share by next year.

stories.title: Triumph Motorcycles launches the Tracker 400 in India at ₹2.46 lakh, - ET Auto
BMW R 12 G/S launched in India at Rs 25.40 lakh
stories.summary: BMW Motorrad has introduced the R 12 G/S in India, priced at Rs 25.40 lakh. The retro-styled adventure motorcycle is available exclusively in the Pro variant, which includes standard Comfort and Enduro packages. The design draws inspiration from the 1980 R 80 G/S model.

stories.title: Electric two wheelers will not need incentives for long, says Okinawa - ET Auto
Mahindra and Uber partner to increase electric three-wheeler use
stories.summary: Mahindra Last Mile Mobility and Uber have signed an agreement to support the adoption of 5,000 electric three-wheelers over the next year. The initiative aims to improve financing access for drivers in markets where electric vehicle adoption remains low, using the EV Auto Advantage programme.

For decades, those vehicles have run on fossil fuels,

stories.title: Mahindra Last Mile Mobility wins 2026 Earthshot Prize
stories.summary: Mahindra Last Mile Mobility has won the 2026 Earthshot Prize in the Clean Our Air category. The company is recognised for its electric small commercial vehicles, having sold over 4,00,000 units and reportedly avoiding 1,85,000 metric tonnes of CO2 emissions. The award highlights the intersection of commerce and emissions.

stories.title: BYD India crosses 20,000 customer deliveries, doubles volumes in a year - ET Auto
PM E-DRIVE scheme records 30 lakh electric vehicle sales
stories.summary: Minister for Heavy Industries HD Kumaraswamy stated that over 30 lakh electric vehicles have been sold under the PM E-DRIVE scheme as of 30 September. The government has allocated Rs 11,980 crore to the initiative, with officials emphasising the need for a wider charging network.

stories.title: PM advisor criticises discoms over electric vehicle charging
stories.summary: Tarun Kapoor, advisor to the Prime Minister, stated that electricity distribution companies are not sufficiently cooperative regarding electric vehicle charging infrastructure. He called for the appointment of nodal officers at each discom to resolve high connection costs and address the low utilisation of public charging stations.

stories.title: PMO official warns discoms of rising electric vehicle power demand
stories.summary: Tarun Kapoor, advisor to the Prime Minister, told power distribution companies to prepare for a sharp increase in electricity demand from electric vehicles. He noted that while discoms currently prioritise industrial revenue, electric vehicles will become one of the largest sectors for power consumption in the future.

stories.title: Kia, Lucid and Volkswagen offer Black Friday EV discounts
stories.summary: Several automakers are offering discounts of $10,000 or more on select electric vehicles for Black Friday. US electric vehicle sales reached 263,000 in the third quarter, the highest since 2025, as manufacturers attempt to move inventory following a period of slowed market growth.

Hyundai Ioniq 5 becomes best-selling non-Tesla EV in US
stories.summary: Hyundai has sold 20,730 Ioniq 5 units this year, a 9 percent increase over 2025. This makes it the best-selling electric vehicle in the United States that is not produced by Tesla. The company continues to compete for the second-place position in the American market.

stories.title: Aptera builds its first production solar EV
stories.summary: Aptera has completed its first production solar electric vehicle for a customer, marking a milestone for the three-wheeled startup. The matte black vehicle, finished in a color called Noir, is expected to be exported outside the United States. After years of development, the vehicle has finally arrived.

stories.title: Energy In Motion secures order for 500 electric trucks
stories.summary: Energy In Motion will supply 500 electric heavy-duty tractors to Sorigin Green Mobility for use on India’s major freight corridors. The deal includes battery-swapping services and charging infrastructure. Nearly 150 of the company's electric trucks were already operating at the Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority as of September.

stories.title: SUN Mobility and the role of battery swapping
stories.summary: India’s electric mobility market has diverged from the car-led models of Europe and China. Government policy and investors like Vitol focus on the country’s 160 million two- and three-wheelers. Battery swapping is considered most suited to these vehicles because their smaller batteries are easier to exchange.

stories.title: Montra Electric rolls out 1,000th Rhino truck, claims first Indian OEM to reach milestone - ET Auto
Montra Electric deploys e-tractors at Action TESA
stories.summary: Montra Electric has deployed seven E-45 electric tractors at an Action TESA manufacturing facility in Visakhapatnam. The initiative aims to bring electric mobility into the MDF manufacturing sector. Action TESA is evaluating the tractors as a sustainable alternative to conventional industrial material-handling equipment.

stories.title: Fiat Ducato tipper now available with a double cab - Automotive World
Mexico heavy vehicle sales grow 26.8 percent
stories.summary: Mexico reported a 26.8 percent year-over-year increase in heavy-vehicle wholesale sales for October, while light-vehicle retail sales rose 3.1 percent. Industrial Info Resources data indicates US$11.81 billion in potential automotive investments in the country. Heavy vehicle growth continues despite mixed trends in light vehicle production and exports.

stories.title: Sand mafia attacks forest team in Madhya Pradesh
stories.summary: A forest team in Sheopur was attacked by a group of men while attempting to seize a tractor-trolley used for illegal sand transportation. Two forest personnel were injured in the clash, which involved stones and sticks. Police have arrested two suspects following the incident.

stories.title: Forest team attacked during tractor seizure in Sheopur
stories.summary: Members of the National Chambal Sanctuary team were attacked by a sand mafia group while attempting to stop illegal sand shipments. The assailants crashed a government vehicle and injured a forest guard before reclaiming a confiscated tractor-trolley. The incident was captured on video during a road chase.

stories.title: Suspects flee with seized tractor-trailer in Moga
stories.summary: Suspected members of an illegal mining syndicate snatched a tractor-trailer from a Mining Department team in Moga. After dumping the sand on a public road, the group fled with the vehicle. Officials had intercepted the tractor earlier for failing to produce transport documents.

stories.title: Mahindra launches compact harvester for small farms
stories.summary: Mahindra and Mahindra has launched the Harvest Yuva, a 50HP self-propelled compact harvester. Designed for small and marginal landholdings, the machine features a narrow width for operation on restricted approach roads. The company is the world's largest tractor manufacturer by volume.

stories.title: Toyota, Nissan, and Honda to standardize vehicle parts
stories.summary: Toyota, Nissan, and Honda will begin standardizing vehicle parts to lower production costs. The automakers plan to implement consistent protocols for plastics and a universal color-coding scheme for wiring harnesses. Discussions with domestic suppliers are underway, with international suppliers expected to join the effort soon.

Bridgestone extends Lamborghini Temerario tyre supply
stories.summary: Bridgestone has expanded its original equipment supply for the Lamborghini Temerario to include the open-top Spyder model. The tyre range, which was previously developed for the Coupé, is available in eight sizes across 20-inch and 21-inch diameters. The tyres are designed for road and track performance.

stories.title: Modernising tyre retail in India
stories.summary: Tyre retail in India is shifting from a functional transaction at neighbourhood shops to a technology-enabled service industry. The evolution includes a focus on trained technicians and improved equipment. The buying experience is increasingly being treated as a value proposition rather than a simple replacement process.

stories.title: Bombay HC restricts NRB Industrial Bearings
stories.summary: The Bombay High Court issued an interim order restraining NRB Industrial Bearings from using the 'NRB Industrial' mark on automotive and farm equipment bearings. The company has halted dispatches of affected stock, though it may continue using the mark for industrial applications. Final arbitration is pending.

GYS and Madhus partner to focus on Indian body shops
stories.summary: French welding firm GYS is partnering with Madhus Garage Equipment to expand its presence in India. The company aims to pair its equipment with training to ensure the tools pay for themselves. The group sales director recently visited training centres in Delhi and Bangalore to oversee the effort.

stories.title: Philippine car sales rise in October
stories.summary: Total car sales in the Philippines reached 36,938 units in October, a 3.4 percent increase over the previous month. Despite the monthly gain, sales remain 7.8 percent lower than the same period last year. Industry leaders suggest that maintaining 40,000 units reflects momentum amid challenging market conditions.

Swansway Motor Group wins industry award
stories.summary: Swansway Motor Group was named Used Car Dealer Group of the Year at the 2026 Motor Trader Industry Awards. The family owned business, which is based in Crewe, received the recognition at a ceremony in London. The company is currently celebrating 23 years in operation.

Scottish dealer retains licence after dispute
stories.summary: A Scottish used car dealer has been granted a licence renewal following a challenge from a customer over a faulty Nissan Qashqai. The local licensing board overruled the objection after the dealer agreed to have the vehicle MOT tested. The business continues to trade.

Central Bank of India disburses 70 crore in loans
stories.summary: The Central Bank of India disbursed 70 crore in loans to entrepreneurs during a credit outreach camp in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar. The bank also received 35 crore in additional loan proposals during the event. The programme was designed to facilitate access to finance for local small and medium enterprises.

stories.title: Deneb Investments to sell Formex Industries
stories.summary: Deneb Investments has reached an agreement to sell its subsidiary, Formex Industries, to VM Automotive. The deal is valued at 435 million rand. The transaction marks a shift in the investment firm's portfolio as it offloads the automotive manufacturing business.

stories.title: VinFast price cut lowers insurance premiums
stories.summary: The VinFast VF MPV 7 price was reduced by 4.1 lakh to 20.39 lakh ex-showroom. While the lower price reduces insurance premiums and own-damage payouts, the vehicle remains unchanged. The car still features the same battery pack and equipment as before the price adjustment.

stories.title: US subprime auto loan delinquencies reach record highs
stories.summary: Fitch Ratings reports that US subprime auto loan delinquencies reached 6.3 percent in October 2026, surpassing levels seen during the global financial crisis. Rising vehicle prices, fuel costs, and interest rates are cited as primary factors. Borrowers with lower credit scores are facing increasing pressure to manage debt.

stories.title: UK regulators propose cyber resilience rules for finance firms
stories.summary: UK regulators have proposed new cyber resilience guidance for financial firms, including car dealership lenders. The move follows a record number of cyber incident reports received by the FCA in October. The proposals aim to clarify existing operational expectations for firms following several high profile industry attacks.

stories.title: Ken Garff Automotive to host noteholder call
stories.summary: Ken Garff Automotive will host a conference call for noteholders and prospective institutional purchasers on December 3 to discuss Q3 2026 financial results. Access to the call is restricted to those currently holding credentials for the company private data room. The company is keeping the details private.

Autonomous vehicle software requires deeper security analysis
stories.summary: Architecture-level analysis is insufficient for securing autonomous driving systems due to their high software complexity. Security teams must now examine actual code, runtime behavior, and safety-critical data flows to identify risks. Architecture diagrams are apparently not enough to stop a car from thinking for itself.

Fidelity report projects software-defined vehicle market growth
stories.summary: The software-defined vehicle market is projected to reach USD 310.46 billion by 2035, growing at a 20.74% CAGR. Fidelity Investments provided the outlook for the sector. The firm notes that users who share this information must ensure they are sending it to people they actually know.

stories.title: Automotive ECU market continues to expand
stories.summary: The automotive electronic control unit market is on a robust growth trajectory, driven by the increasing integration of vehicle electronics and new control system innovations. The market is set to expand further as manufacturers continue to prioritize technology integration. Electronics are becoming a standard feature of the car.

stories.title: Ransomware groups target manufacturing and automotive supply chains
stories.summary: Manufacturing remained a prime target for cybercriminals in 2026, with 1,379 recorded extortion claims between January and October. Industrial products accounted for the majority of incidents, followed by automotive at 11.3%. The Qilin, The Gentlemen and Akira groups were identified as the most active participants.

stories.title: E20 fuel norms impact Punjab used-car market
stories.summary: Dealers in Punjab report a slump in petrol-powered used-car sales following the mandatory rollout of E20 fuel. Consumers are shifting toward diesel, CNG, and electric alternatives instead. The Karnataka government has also raised concerns regarding fuel quality and blending limits. The market is adjusting to the new mix.

stories.title: Ford, Honda, Stellantis, Volkswagen sue to block New Jersey dealership warranty pay law - Automotive News
Congress nears deal on Chinese car ban
stories.summary: US lawmakers are finalizing legislation to block Chinese-made cars from the domestic market. The deal may include exemptions for automakers like Mercedes-Benz if Chinese ownership stakes are deemed passive. The bill is intended to reach the President's desk before January. Ownership is now a matter of geography.

stories.title: Scottish Transport Secretary defends EV sales targets
stories.summary: Scottish Transport Secretary Stephen Flynn stated that weakening UK-wide EV sales targets without consultation is wholly unacceptable. The Climate Change Committee recently affirmed that the current mandate is working effectively. Going slow on electric vehicles could reportedly increase emissions by 10 percent at a critical time.

stories.title: UK reviews EV sales mandate ahead of 2030 target, Climate Change Committee highlights implications - AL Circle
India revises PUC certificate validity rules
stories.summary: The Ministry of Road Transport and Highways has updated emission testing rules, extending PUC validity for newer BS6 vehicles to 3 years. Conversely, BS4 and older vehicles face more frequent inspections. The new timelines take effect upon the renewal of existing certificates. Older cars are aging out of convenience.

stories.title: Electric vehicle registrations in Türkiye exceed 500,000
stories.summary: The number of registered electric vehicles in Türkiye reached 501,005 in October, according to the Turkish Statistical Institute. This represents a 50.9 percent increase compared to the previous year. The country has reached a new milestone in its vehicle fleet composition.

stories.title: Turkey’s trade minister urges EU to include it in ‘Made in Europe’ rules - Automotive News
Stellantis’ Peugeot, Citroen, Opel brands to exit motorsports, report says - Automotive News
India launches first hydrogen-powered train
stories.summary: Indian Railways has inaugurated its first hydrogen fuel cell-powered train, marking a transition toward clean transportation. The locomotive generates electricity onboard and is scheduled to operate on the Jind-Sonipat section of the Northern Railway. The project combines advanced propulsion technology with dedicated hydrogen storage and refuelling infrastructure.

stories.title: Saarthi GreenTech looks to retrofit diesel engines
stories.summary: Saarthi GreenTech is exploring the retrofitting of existing diesel engines to reduce carbon emissions. Co-founder Alok Kumar suggests that replacing entire fleets is costly and that modifying engines already on the road offers a more practical solution to the carbon dilemma facing industrial and transport sectors.

Alabama auto parts plant to close in December
stories.summary: An auto parts manufacturing facility in Alabama will close next month, according to state records. The company filed a WARN Act notice, which requires employers to provide 60 days of advance written notice for significant layoffs or plant closures to help workers prepare for the loss of employment.

stories.title: Nissan and BMW adjust operations in Mexico
stories.summary: Nissan is using Mexico as a testing ground to achieve cost parity against Chinese competitors. Meanwhile, BMW has moved its San Luis Potosí plant to a single-shift schedule and cut 2 percent of staff ahead of 2027 electric vehicle production, prompting legal pushback from the LSOM union.

stories.title: Tesla plans German factory expansion for robotaxis
stories.summary: Tesla will invest 2.6 billion pounds to expand its German Gigafactory, aiming to produce one million driverless Cybercabs annually. The new facility will manufacture vehicles without steering wheels or pedals. The expansion arrives as domestic German manufacturers are restructuring operations and cutting jobs to compete with Chinese brands.

research.title: A Synthetic Multi-Modal Testbed for Security Stress Testing of Agentic Counter-UAS Systems
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Agentic cyber-physical systems rely on perception and state estimation to support autonomous decisions. Degraded, inconsistent, or manipulated sensor observations can therefore propagate through an autonomous pipeline and create security-relevant failures. This work presents a synthetic Counter-Unmanned. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Bridging vision-language reasoning and learned control for legged navigation in the wild
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Autonomous navigation in diverse real-world environments remains one of the greatest challenges in robotics. It demands both robust low-level motion control to handle diverse terrain and high-level reasoning to interpret environmental cues. We present ROAM (Robust. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Communication-Aware UAV Spatio-Temporal Relay Cooperation and Planning in Complex Urban Environments
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) are increasingly deployed in low-altitude urban airspace for delivery, emergency response, and other applications. However, UAV mobility across spatially heterogeneous urban communication environments can lead to time-varying communication outages, disrupting mission execution. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: DARSY: A Tool for Data-Driven Abstraction and Policy Synthesis for Stochastic Systems with Unknown Dynamics
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper presents DARSY: a software tool for abstraction-based verification and policy synthesis in discrete-time stochastic control systems with unknown dynamics and noise distributions. DARSY requires only a simulator of the system and a Lipschitz bound. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Differentiable Hydrodynamics for Whole-Body MPC of Underwater Robots
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Underwater vehicle-manipulator systems distribute actuation across thrusters and joint motors. Whole-body model predictive control (MPC), rather than separate vehicle and arm controllers, can coordinate both to extend the workspace and exploit the system's full kinematic capability. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: How to Effectively Manage the Energy in Residential Systems: Development and Comparison of Methods
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: The transition from fossil fuels presents significant challenges in energy management. To ensure a sustainable energy future, it is crucial to reduce energy consumption when possible and to synchronize electricity consumption and storage with the production. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Learning to Move from and for Manipulation Policies: Spatializing Latent Action Representations for Goal-Pose-Free Mobile Manipulation
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: The success of manipulation policies is closely tied to the spatial relationship between the robot and the target object, as well as the task being performed, making the ability to adjust the robot's pose critical for. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
